scope.purpose: primitive, result-free input for an exact divided-cubic recomputation

predecessor_reaudit.role: provenance only; neither predecessor file is read by the public recomputation

point_push.basepoint: immediately after r_xy word letter 1, the y+ W1 rung
forward_component_route: connector after r_xy letter 1: segments 5,6,7 (segment 6 x increases)
r_xy letter 2 z- rung and connector 2
r_xy letter 3 y- rung and connector 3
connector after r_xy letter 0: segments 1,2,3 (segment 2 x decreases)
return to r_xy letter 1 y+ W1 rung
point_push.composition_rule: R rows in increasing-x segment-6 order, followed by L rows in decreasing-x segment-2 order; local L/R charts retain the oriented source crossing sign

chronology.emitter_rule_source_text: horizontal segments in component/segment order; crossings on each horizontal segment sorted by increasing x
chronology.finding_source_text: segment 2 is traversed in decreasing x and segment 6 in increasing x; emitter order is not point-push chronology; oriented word traversal selects R(x increasing) followed by L(x decreasing)

point_push.cabling_rule: sigma_i -> [2i,2i+1,2i-1,2i], with inverse word for sigma_i^-1

endpoint_model.endpoint_terms_rule: the cup vector u and cap row ell are derived from the endpoint convention (transport monomials, canonical coevaluation, pivotal evaluation) by scripts/build_t73_endpoint_transport.py; hand-written terms are not accepted

Hattori_components: eta_Rw[T1] -> Id_(W W^-1 U1)=Id_U1 tensor X^227
source_extract.anchor_control: when W=I the two framing-corrected objects coincide and xi_Omega=0
source_extract.choose: U1=the physical cross-owner cup mapped by B88_POSITION_TO_PASSAGE_TABLE.json to collar positions 2 (r_xy letter 3 negative) and 87 (m_2 letter 310 positive)
source_extract.psi_through_degree: psi pair creation preserves the old through degree 86 while adding a Frobenius cup factor; psi0 and psi1 are distinguished only after the W2 core counit, not by a through-degree drop
source_extract.relative_class: xi_Omega=eta_Rw[F_Omega^-1 U1] - s_inv*eta_Rw[F_Omega^-1 W^-1 U1], where s_inv is the finite signed braid-cancellation calibration
source_extract.signed_chain_calibration: choose s_inv to be the +/-1 assigned by the fixed functorial convention to the explicit W W^-1 cancellation movie; this is a finite definition of the source linear combination, not a kappa comparison

hattori_binding.token_convention: uppercase W/F are generators, lowercase w/f their inverses; U is the chosen cup object
